package.name: cmd_vel_arbiter
package.description: twist_mux-based command arbiter for the hexapod: joystick (priority 100) over the ROS 2 bridge floor (priority 10), with an /estop_lock priority-255 lock. Bundles the launch file, the two twist_mux config YAMLs, and the cmd_vel_squelch node that gates the joystick's idle zero-stream so it doesn't starve the lower-priority ROS 2 path.
